functional_requirements.text: Torrent search will share the same search bar with the streaming search.
Database of torrent sites can be updated via the internet.
There will be a tick box to allow the user to choose to include torrent searching in the search.
Query will retrieve the no. of seed and peers, size of the file, date posted and a link to the webpage itself.
If no results are found on a search it will display a message “No results were found for this search.”
Results will be arranged in size/date/alphabetical order by clicking on the column headers.
There will be page button for the user to navigate the results.

from fastapi import APIRouter, Body, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.extensions import Base, SessionLocal
from app.models.torrent import Torrent
from app.models.streaming import Streaming

router = APIRouter()

def search_torrents_and_streaming(query: str) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]]:
    """
    The system processes the query string and returns search results relevant to the query from both torrent and streaming sources.

    Args:
        query: The search query string entered by the user in the shared search bar

    Returns:
        Search results from both torrent and streaming sources, formatted as a dictionary with keys 'torrents' and 'streaming'

    Notes:
        Postcondition: The search results displayed reflect the query entered by the user and include items from both torrent and streaming databases
        canonical call (must work): {"query":"pizza"}
        must return on success: {"torrents": [], "streaming": []}
        error mode: raise
    """
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Search for torrents matching the query
        torrent_results = db.query(Torrent).filter(Torrent.title.contains(query)).all()
        
        # Search for streaming items matching the query
        streaming_results = db.query(Streaming).filter(Streaming.title.contains(query)).all()
        
        # Format results
        torrents = [
            {
                "id": str(torrent.id),
                "title": torrent.title,
                "size": torrent.size,
                "seeders": str(torrent.seeders)
            }
            for torrent in torrent_results
        ]
        
        streaming = [
            {
                "id": str(streaming.id),
                "title": streaming.title,
                "duration": streaming.duration,
                "is_available": str(streaming.is_available)
            }
            for streaming in streaming_results
        ]
        
        return {
            "torrents": torrents,
            "streaming": streaming
        }
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error")
    finally:
        db.close()

from fastapi import APIRouter, Body, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.extensions import Base, SessionLocal

class Torrent(Base):
    __tablename__ = "torrents"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    seeds = Column(Integer)
    peers = Column(Integer)
    size = Column(String)
    date_posted = Column(String)
    link = Column(String)

router = APIRouter()

@router.post("")
def search_torrents(query: str = Body(..., embed=True)) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        results = db.query(Torrent).filter(Torrent.id.like(f"%{query}%")).all()
        if not results:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="No torrents found for the given query")
        
        response = []
        for result in results:
            response.append({
                "seeds": str(result.seeds),
                "peers": str(result.peers),
                "size": result.size,
                "date_posted": result.date_posted,
                "link": result.link
            })
        return response
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        db.close()

from fastapi import APIRouter, Body, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.extensions import Base, SessionLocal


class SearchResult(Base):
    __tablename__ = "search_results"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    size = Column(String)


router = APIRouter()


@router.post("")
def paginate_search_results(
    page_number: int = Body(..., embed=True),
    page_size: int = Body(..., embed=True),
    search_query: str = Body(..., embed=True),
) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]]:
    if page_number < 1:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Page number must be greater than 0")
    
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        offset = (page_number - 1) * page_size
        results = (
            db.query(SearchResult)
            .filter(SearchResult.name.contains(search_query))
            .offset(offset)
            .limit(page_size)
            .all()
        )
        
        formatted_results = [
            {"name": result.name, "size": result.size}
            for result in results
        ]
        
        return {"results": formatted_results}
    finally:
        db.close()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import create_app

client = TestClient(create_app())

def test_search_torrents_and_streaming():
    # Test case 1: Canonical case with pizza query
    resp = client.post("/controllers/search_torrents_and_streaming", json={"query":"pizza"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == {"torrents": [], "streaming": []}

    # Test case 2: Search with empty string query
    resp = client.post("/controllers/search_torrents_and_streaming", json={"query":""})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == {"torrents": [], "streaming": []}

    # Test case 3: Search with special characters
    resp = client.post("/controllers/search_torrents_and_streaming", json={"query":"!@#$%^&*()"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == {"torrents": [], "streaming": []}

    # Test case 4: Search with long query string
    resp = client.post("/controllers/search_torrents_and_streaming", json={"query":"this is a very long query string that exceeds typical search lengths and might cause issues if not handled properly"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == {"torrents": [], "streaming": []}

import json
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import create_app

client = TestClient(create_app())

def test_sort_torrent_results_anchor_case():
    resp = client.post("/views/sort_torrent_results", json={"results":[{"name":"movie1","size":"1GB","date":"2023-01-01"},{"name":"movie2","size":"2GB","date":"2023-01-02"}],"sort_by":"size"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == [{"name": "movie1", "size": "1GB", "date": "2023-01-01"}, {"name": "movie2", "size": "2GB", "date": "2023-01-02"}]

def test_sort_torrent_results_by_date():
    resp = client.post("/views/sort_torrent_results", json={"results":[{"name":"movie2","size":"2GB","date":"2023-01-02"},{"name":"movie1","size":"1GB","date":"2023-01-01"}],"sort_by":"date"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == [{"name": "movie1", "size": "1GB", "date": "2023-01-01"}, {"name": "movie2", "size": "2GB", "date": "2023-01-02"}]

def test_sort_torrent_results_alphabetical():
    resp = client.post("/views/sort_torrent_results", json={"results":[{"name":"movie2","size":"2GB","date":"2023-01-02"},{"name":"movie1","size":"1GB","date":"2023-01-01"}],"sort_by":"alphabetical"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == [{"name": "movie1", "size": "1GB", "date": "2023-01-01"}, {"name": "movie2", "size": "2GB", "date": "2023-01-02"}]

def test_sort_torrent_results_empty_list():
    resp = client.post("/views/sort_torrent_results", json={"results":[],"sort_by":"size"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == []

def test_sort_torrent_results_invalid_sort_by():
    resp = client.post("/views/sort_torrent_results", json={"results":[],"sort_by":"invalid_sort"})
    assert resp.status_code >= 400
